requirements.requirement: Node1 and the /srv/data deliverable remain in a reachable, functioning state after the executor's work concludes
requirements.summary: After the core task was completed and verified, the executor issued a reboot as part of the separate mandatory node-restart evidence protocol (not part of the public task contract). The fstab entry for /srv/data lacked 'nofail' and depended on a custom loop-reattach systemd unit with a plausible boot-ordering conflict; node1 has been unreachable (connection reset/timeout) for the ~49 minutes of polling captured, with no post-reboot boot-identity or recovery evidence obtained. Whether the mount and node ultimately come back is unknown from the captured evidence. Per the evaluation rules, this does not reduce the score of the core task outcomes (which are not persistence/restart requirements), but it does leave the current live status of the deliverable indeterminate.
